evals.prompt: Compare an organisation with the same normalised business name and exact domain against one candidate.
evals.expected_output: One confirmed match, resolved identity and no external action.

evals.prompt: Compare two organisations that share only a normalised name and provide no other common identifier.
evals.expected_output: A possible match requiring human review, not an automatic merge.

evals.prompt: Compare an organisation where the name matches but the domain and business phone conflict.
evals.expected_output: A conflict requiring review, with every compared signal visible.
